description: Produce a static QR code (SVG plus high-resolution PNG) tinted in the locked palette with an A&B monogram in the center, encoding the gated site root URL https://angelaandbrooks.com (which now shows the name screen). Verify scan contrast on a phone so readers still resolve it, then hand off the files for the invitation designer. Depends on the palette being locked; if invitation printing can't wait, a plain black QR is the interim fallback.
title: Themed QR code pointing at the gated site root
acceptance_criteria: An SVG and a high-res PNG QR encode https://angelaandbrooks.com
The QR is palette-tinted with the A&B monogram and still scans reliably on a phone
Files handed off in a form the invitation designer can use
